thread:
sam: Hey team — escalated from ACME. They saw a sudden latency jump + cross-region egress spike after last config push. Customer says all requests started routing to eu-central despite policy claiming us-west primary.

maria: Ack — do we have the failover policy they applied?

sam: Pasted below from their UI export (redacted):

sam: ```
priority: [1,0,2]
weights: [10,50,40]
sticky_ttl: 300
regions:
  - us-west-2
  - eu-central-1
  - ap-southeast-1
```

jia: hmm that priority array looks suspicious. UI sends positional arrays and our parser expects a mapping {region:priority}. If indexes shift, priorities could be assigned to wrong regions.

ingrid: Also sticky_ttl is documented as seconds, but the UI tooltip says ms in older builds. If TTL parsed as ms that would be 300ms not 300s. Could explain cookies expiring immediately and sticky losing affinity.

sam: Customer logs showing routing decisions: 

sam: ```
[2026-10-03T18:03:12Z] req_id=abc123 user=acct-ACME routed_to=eu-central-1 policy_priority=[1,0,2] selected_index=0 resolved_region=eu-central-1
[2026-10-03T18:03:12Z] req_id=abc124 user=acct-ACME routed_to=eu-central-1 policy_priority=[1,0,2] selected_index=1 resolved_region=eu-central-1
```

maria: Whoa selected_index != resolved_region mapping matches: index 0 -> eu-central even though region list shows us-west first. Looks like we treat priority array indices as applying to sorted regions, not the order they were supplied. Parser bug.

jia: Repro plan: 1) apply their exact export to a staging route 2) generate requests with header x-customer-region-preference: us-west-2 3) inspect routing-decision log and cookie set.

ingrid: I can repro locally. Using the export, our routing engine sorts region names alphabetically before zipping with priorities. Because eu-central-1 sorts before us-west-2, the priority mapping got flipped.

sam: That explains cross-region egress + latency. Any auth issues? Customer also reported intermittent 401s.

jia: 401s likely from sticky TTL parsed as ms — sessions appear unauthenticated when cookie dropped quickly and traffic hits region with different session DB. Combined misroute + TTL = auth errors.

ops-bot: Deployed canary 0.65.2 -> routing-parser (host=router-3) at 2026-10-03T18:10:00Z

maria: Immediate mitigation options for customer: 1) Pin route to us-west-2 via admin override 2) Force-policy to map by region name instead of index 3) Disable sticky to avoid auth bounce until patch. Which do we recommend?

ingrid: Recommend admin-pin + disable sticky. Pin avoids cross-region and billing spike.

sam: I pushed admin pin for acct-ACME to us-west-2 and disabled sticky for their route. Will monitor.

billing-bot: Alert: acct-ACME egress costs spiked from $120/day to $3,400/day between 2026-10-03T17:50 and 2026-10-03T18:05 (estimated).

maria: We'll offer credit for spike and explain root cause. Jia, do we have a patch ETA?

jia: Patch: change parser to accept positional arrays only if region array present and do not sort; also add validation warning when positions used. I'll have a hotfix PR within 2 hours, testing in staging then can roll.

sam: Customer update sent: "We've pinned your route to us-west-2 and disabled session stickiness while we fix parser. We're crediting the unexpected egress charges and pushing a fix ASAP." (customer acknowledged, trying repro runs now). :thumbsup:

maria: Followups: 1) Docs update to clarify sticky_ttl units and deprecate positional priority arrays. 2) Add CI test to prevent alphabetical reordering when exporting/importing policy. 3) Billing ops to start credit workflow.

ingrid: Confirming canary with patch looks good in staging — mapping preserved when importing export. No more alphabetical reorder.

ops-bot: Canary 0.65.3 -> routing-parser (hosts=router-2,router-3) at 2026-10-03T19:35:00Z

jia: Rolling to prod in next maintenance window unless anyone objects.

sam: No objections. Closing loop with ACME after prod roll.

maria: Thanks everyone — filing postmortem epic and linking this thread.

sam: FYI I'll attach customer logs to the support ticket (redacted) and include the pinned change id.
